localChanges: A new game now asks for a difficulty level, Chieftain (easiest) to Emperor (toughest), after the size of the world and before the number of civilizations. It starts on the level you chose last time, or Prince (#173).

The level sets how many of your citizens are born content (six on Chieftain down to two on Emperor), and how soon a large empire makes them unhappy. It also sets what your research costs, and what the computer players pay for research, buildings and growth. On Chieftain you start with 50 gold.
Research costs twice as much from AD onwards, and more again when the leading civilization is ahead of schedule, as in Civilization.
The level is kept in your save and shown under the year. Loading a game saved before there were levels asks you to choose one.
